audit.notes: Can be completely recreated using any two contrasting clips from the creator's library: one somber or tired clip (e.g. staring pensively on the subway, looking exhausted after working or climbing) followed by an upbeat clip (e.g. laughing with friends in Chinatown or smiling at home). Simply paste the emoji grids and copy the audio.
audit.summary: A motivational perspective reel contrasting 'one bad month' (visualized as a 5x6 grid of red dots) with 'not a bad life' (visualized as a massive grid of white dots with just one red dot), set to a somber then uplifting audio transition.
